paper: Urazhdin 2024, arXiv:2408.08683v3 -- Atomic and inter-atomic orbital magnetization induced in SrTiO3 by chiral phonons
headline_anchor: MO level structure + bandgap Delta = 3.2 eV; diagonalized spectrum matches analytic Eqs.(1)-(3) to machine precision; Koster-Slater chain and mu_1=1.6 muB reproduce within <=2%.

open_questions.question: Does the qualitatively-invoked inter-atomic Berry curvature Omega_xy = 2 Im(<d_Qy psi | d_Qx psi>) actually integrate to a moment consistent with Eq.(18), when computed non-perturbatively over the 2D ionic-displacement manifold Q=(Qx,Qy)?
open_questions.why_heavy: The paper asserts a finite Berry curvature underlies the inter-atomic contribution but never evaluates it; verifying it requires differentiating the exact (non-perturbative) MO ground state w.r.t. the two displacement components and integrating the curvature over the displacement cycle, then reconciling with the perturbative Eq.(15)-(18) circulating-current result.
open_questions.compute_needed: nuc13-CPU / spark-local: exact 6-state diagonalization on a 2D (Qx,Qy) grid + finite-difference Berry curvature; minutes.

open_questions.question: Beyond first-order TDPT, does a full time-dependent (non-perturbative) propagation of the 6-state MO wavefunction under Q(t)=Q0(cos wt, c sin wt) reproduce the same transient moment and the Eq.(9) ~6e-5 residual population, and how does it behave as hbar*omega -> Delta (resonance)?
open_questions.why_heavy: The paper's virtual-excitation interpretation rests on the leading-order Eq.(9) smallness; a non-perturbative Floquet/real-time integration is needed to confirm the moment is genuinely a dressing effect (not accumulating real population) and to map the resonant divergence honestly.
open_questions.compute_needed: nuc13-CPU: real-time RK4/Floquet propagation of a 6x6 time-periodic Hamiltonian; seconds-minutes per frequency.

open_questions.question: What is the induced orbital moment when the minimal single-Ti-plaquette MO model is embedded in a periodic k-space band structure of cubic STO (full Ti t2g + O 2p manifold), and does the k-integrated orbital magnetization recover the real-space MO estimate?
open_questions.why_heavy: The paper deliberately uses a local (non-periodic) MO cluster; promoting it to a periodic tight-binding band model and computing the modern-theory-of-orbital-magnetization (Berry-phase L_z) k-integral is a substantially larger build and is the bridge between this toy model and a DFT-comparable number.
open_questions.compute_needed: uicgpu-A100 or nuc13: multiband periodic TB + modern-theory orbital magnetization; or DFT+Wannier for material-specific onsite/hopping.

open_questions.question: The paper's absolute moment is smaller than the observed MOKE signal and it conjectures additional constructive contributions (plaquette currents through Ti vortices; dxy, px, py orbitals and their bonds). How large are these omitted channels, and do they actually add constructively by the angular-momentum-conservation argument?
open_questions.why_heavy: Requires extending the basis to the full multi-orbital plaquette (not just d_sigma + pz) and separately the Ti-vortex plaquette current, then checking relative signs -- a from-scratch enlargement of the model, and the crux of whether the mechanism can account for experiment.
open_questions.compute_needed: nuc13-CPU: enlarged MO Hamiltonian (12-20 states) + TDPT; hours of model-building, minutes of compute.

open_questions.question: How sensitive are the atomic (Eq.8) and inter-atomic (Eq.18) moments to first-principles-corrected values of a_t, a_l (i.e. replacing the semi-empirical r^{-7/2} Koster-Slater scaling with DFT-derived Ti-O hopping derivatives), and does the ~1.6x atomic:inter-atomic ratio survive?
open_questions.why_heavy: The paper flags a_t, a_l as order-of-magnitude semi-empirical estimates and calls for ab-initio refinement; obtaining d t_TiO / d r from frozen-phonon DFT and propagating the uncertainty into both moments tests the robustness of the paper's central 'comparable contributions' claim.
open_questions.compute_needed: uicgpu-A100: frozen-phonon DFT of STO to extract t_TiO(r) and its derivative; then re-evaluate Eqs.(8),(18).

next_steps: Q1: compute Omega_xy on a (Qx,Qy) grid via finite-difference of the exact 6-state ground state and compare the integrated inter-atomic moment to Eq.(18).
Q2: implement a real-time RK4 propagator for the 6x6 time-periodic MO Hamiltonian; verify Eq.(9) residual and scan hbar*omega/Delta toward resonance.
Q3: build a periodic multiband STO tight-binding model and evaluate the modern-theory orbital magnetization k-integral.
Q4: enlarge the basis to include dxy/px/py and the Ti-vortex plaquette current; check constructive addition of channels.
Q5: extract t_TiO(r) from frozen-phonon DFT (uicgpu) and re-evaluate a_t, a_l, and the atomic:inter-atomic moment ratio.
